templates.incident-triage.name: Incident triage → GitHub + Slack
templates.incident-triage.description: Webhook receives an incident, AI summarizes it, GitHub gets a tracking issue, Slack notifies the on-call channel.
templates.customer-escalation-router.des: Webhook receives a complaint, AI classifies severity, and condition-guarded edges fan out to one of three escalation branches: low (Slack ping), medium (GitHub issue + Slack), or high (human review + GitHub issue + urgent Slack alert).
templates.lead-enrichment-handoff.name: Lead enrichment → sales handoff
templates.lead-enrichment-handoff.descri: Webhook receives a marketing-form lead, AI scores and enriches it, and a condition routes qualified leads to Slack + a welcome email while unqualified leads receive a nurture-sequence email.
templates.refund-triage-approval.name: Refund triage → approval → billing webhook
templates.refund-triage-approval.descrip: Webhook receives a refund request, AI summarizes the claim, a human approval gate decides yes/no, then a signed webhook calls the billing system and an email confirms to the customer.
templates.ai-support-draft-review.name: AI support draft → human review → send
templates.ai-support-draft-review.descri: Webhook receives a support ticket, AI drafts a response, a human agent reviews/edits via a typed form, and the final reply is emailed to the customer.
templates.churn-risk-weekly-digest.name: Churn-risk weekly digest (scheduled)
templates.churn-risk-weekly-digest.descr: Cron-fires every Monday 9am, pulls at-risk users from a configured analytics endpoint, AI ranks them, then a digest message lands in Slack for the customer-success channel.
tools.pdf-generate.description: Render a Markdown or HTML template into a PDF and upload it to the configured object store.
tools.email-send.description: Send a transactional email via the configured mailer (Resend or SendGrid).
tools.http-request.description: Make an HTTP request to an external API.
tools.text-trim.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from text.
tools.text-replace.description: Replace literal occurrences of a substring (all by default).
tools.text-regex.description: Match a regular expression against text and return capture groups.
tools.json-pick.description: Pick a value from workflow context using a dot path.
tools.json-set.description: Return a copy of `source` with `value` set at the dotted `path`.
tools.json-merge.description: Deep-merge two objects; `b` wins on key conflicts. Arrays are replaced wholesale.
tools.json-jq.description: Run a safe jq-style selector subset against JSON data.
tools.csv-parse.description: Parse a CSV string into rows. Default `hasHeader: true` returns objects keyed by header.
tools.csv-stringify.description: Serialise rows to CSV. Provide `header` for object-rows; omit for array-rows.
tools.csv-filter.description: Filter object-rows by an exact-match `where` map (every entry must match).
tools.time-now.description: Return the current time as ISO + epoch milliseconds.
tools.time-parse.description: Parse an ISO-8601 string or numeric epoch (ms) into both forms.
tools.time-format.description: Format a time value in one of `iso`/`epoch`/`epochSeconds`/`utc`/`rfc2822`.
tools.time-diff.description: Compute b - a as a duration in `unit` (default ms).
tools.time-add.description: Add an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `P3D`, `PT2H30M`) to a time value.
tools.crypto-hmac.description: Compute an HMAC of `value` with `secret` (default `sha256`, `sha512` allowed).
tools.crypto-uuid.description: Generate a v4 UUID via the platform crypto random source.
